A merkle tree is a data structure that allow for verifying that a particular set of data belongs to a larger set.

The root of a merkle tree is a hash of the hashes of the data.

This allows for easy comparisons in a p2p system, where one peer can ask if another for a matching root. If the root matches, then the data set must match.

It also allows for easy verification of a single piece of data, without having all of the data in the tree. You only need to know the root, and the path to the data.
